QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_60

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 224 defines MDD as (Trough Value − Peak Value) / Peak Value, and page 225 applies the same formula in the worked example, expressing the result as a negative percentage. The Trap: Reversing the numerator/denominator or substituting a volatility expression does not match the workbook formula. Note: Page 224 also says investors should pay attention to the time period over which MDD is measured, because the same fund can show very different drawdowns over different windows.
